body:
So I *think* @vanderaj added 18.11 "Verify that alternative and less secure access paths do not exist."

Is there any way a little more detail could be added to this to make it clearer what it is specifically referring to?

comments.body: Agree with this but also not sure it makes any sense. I've replaced the text with sensitive info in URLS but do think we need to spend more time on this overall. The API side is vital we get right, and right now it is missing a lot.

> I've replaced the text with sensitive info in URLS
Interesting twist. URLs clearly contain a thing called path, but I doubt that is what "less secure access paths" was referring to.  

The first part of the original rule about not having alternative access paths should go for sure. It's ok to offer multiple alternative APIs from a security standpoint as long as they're all secured in the same way/to the same level.

That last part is important, though, I think.  And in my eyes it'd be worth having a security rule for that.
Just make it more clear what is actually meant here.

Maybe like this?
"Verify that there are no less secure ways to get the same access (to the service)"

Are there currently style guides for the issues? In my opinion, positive sentences are better, but at first sight, the ASVS uses both positive and negative sentences.

For example, I would propose:
> Verify that all access paths to a resource provide the same level of security
This is resolved for 18.8 please open new ticket if other issues with 18x are outstanding.

title: 18.11 is a little unclear
